description: List the tenant's custom field definitions (optionally filtered to one entity): id, name, fieldName, type, position, options (for list/multilist), item-group limitation and the import-identifier/cost-attribute flags. fieldName is the key used in the customFields map accepted by upsert_items, upsert_customers, create_supplier, update_supplier and create_warehouse.

entity.description: Optional: restrict to one entity (item, member, businessPartner, warehouse, workOrder).

name: list_custom_fields
title: List Custom Fields
